name: Infantry_Pi
author: Infantry AI
description: The pi coding agent harness (HARNESS H6c): launches pi (--mode json, or the persistent --mode rpc), reads its event stream, lists its models, routes its tool calls through the watched runner and carries the to-do extension.

credentials.label: Anthropic
credentials.help: Create an API key in the Anthropic Console (console.anthropic.com). Only needed for the anthropic/* models.

credentials.label: DeepSeek
credentials.help: Create an API key at platform.deepseek.com. Only needed for the deepseek/* models.

credentials.label: Google Gemini
credentials.help: Create an API key in Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com). Only needed for the google/* models.

credentials.label: OpenCode Go
credentials.help: Create an API key in your OpenCode account (opencode.ai). Only needed for the opencode-go/* models.
